scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently identified the build error and correctly determined that LrgWindowsAppManifest was never built (only metadata targets were invoked). However, it fell short on two important aspects: it didn't actually list the projects (just gave a count), and it completely missed the configuration analysis dimension — never comparing Debug vs Release configurations or investigating whether the output path was configuration-dependent. The root cause analysis was shallow, stopping at 'not built' without exploring why (configuration mismatch). Solid but incomplete work.
